title: Do Activity-Based Incentive Plans Work? Evidence from a Large-Scale Field Intervention
eligible_reason: All 305 treated territories in one sales business unit receive ABI interventions at the same dates (Intervention 1 in months 16-21, Intervention 2 in months 22-24, then removal). Tables 2-3 are within-unit before/after regressions with territory and month/year dummies and no comparison group. The comparison with 22 untreated business units uses synthetic control and generalized synthetic control (interactive fixed effects), which are excluded. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: JMR 58(4), 2021. Table 2: outcome = composite activity score (CAS), individual level (N=9,355) and territory level (N=6,386), regressors INTV1 and INTV2 with territory, month, and year dummies. Table 3: outcome = territory-month sales (N=10,927), Model 1 INTV1, INTV2, Target; Model 2 adds NReps and NReps x INTV interactions; SEs clustered by territory. Tables 4-7 are SCM and generalized SCM (3 latent factors, two-way FE). Keywords list synthetic control. All treated territories share the same intervention months, so there is one cohort per intervention.
screener_notes: Not eligible. Common treatment timing across all treated territories; comparison design is synthetic control. Data are from a South Asian pharmaceutical firm plus syndicated market data, with sales scaled to preserve confidentiality. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.

ineligible_specs.reason: single adoption date for all treated units, no untreated comparison unit in the regression
single adoption date for all treated units, no untreated comparison unit; Target and NReps controls and interactions
synthetic control and generalized synthetic control
